newsitem.title: USA: Dow shifts to positive ground, bond yield declines.
newsitem.headline: Dow shifts to positive ground, bond yield declines.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average, which opened lower, turned itself around on Wednesday after the long bond yield fell back to seven percent.

The Dow, which initially gave back some of the gains made in a record finish on Tuesday, was trading up five points to about 7389. Advancing issues outpaced declining issues by a slight margin, after mixed trading most of the day.
The Nasdaq composite rose four points to 1413.
Shares, which some traders had said lacked direction, took their lead from the benchmark 30-year Treasury bond, which rose 11/32 to trade back at a seven percent yield.
